name: roblox_devforum_collaboration-mcp
description: Roblox DevForum — Collaboration (deals): search_postings, get_posting. Every tool maps to a document

tools.name: search_postings
tools.description: GET /search.json?q=<query> category:82 order:latest&page=<page> (Discourse 'Search for a term'), restricted to the Collaboration › Find and Hire Talent ('Post job listings to hire talent.') category (id 82) and newest first. `query` is REQUIRED in practice: without it no q is sent and Discourse returns no topics. Discourse search takes at least 3 characters and supports its advanced filters inside the query (e.g. tags:scripter, after:2026-09-01). category and min_budget are not sent (no budget field on forum topics). Pages hold up to 50 topics (limit is not sent). title/posted_at are the topic's; description is the search excerpt; the topic URL is https://devforum.roblox.com/t/<id>. Posters are matched in the response's separate posts[] list (raw is per topic), so buyer is null here — use get_posting.

tools.name: get_posting
tools.description: GET /t/{id}.json ('Get a single topic'): buyer = the topic creator's username, description = the first post's HTML (post_stream.posts[0].cooked); skills = the topic's tags. The topic URL is https://devforum.roblox.com/t/<id>.
